observations: Photo 0 shows a white MacBook Pro box with a printed image of the laptop on top. The box has a sticker with text: 'MacBook Pro A2422 M1 Pro 16GB 512 SSD 20-4-1100'.

Photo 1 shows the laptop inside the box, closed, with a space gray finish and Apple logo. A handwritten note is taped to the lid, listing specs: 'M1 Pro 16GB 512GB', '14"', '2021', 'SSD', '100% Original', 'No issues', 'Price: 1.4M NGN'.

Photo 2 shows the bottom of the box with the charger and USB-C cable in their compartments. The charger is white and rectangular, typical of Apple's 61W or 96W MagSafe 3 chargers. The cable is USB-C to USB-C.
All photos show a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI MICHAEL BANKY3W'.
The box appears to be in good condition, with no visible damage. The laptop is not powered on or shown open.
